findings.title: Required project repository area is missing
findings.evidence: proj-neuro-marker-001 has no files in notebooks/.
findings.action: Add at least one tracked artifact under notebooks/ before tagging this project version.

findings.title: Required project repository area is missing
findings.evidence: proj-neuro-marker-001 has no files in protocols/.
findings.action: Add at least one tracked artifact under protocols/ before tagging this project version.

findings.title: Tracked file hash does not match content
findings.evidence: data/raw-observations.csv digest does not match the current content payload.
findings.action: Recompute the manifest after the file is saved, or block the export as tampered/stale.

findings.title: Large artifact is not marked for Git LFS
findings.evidence: data/raw-observations.csv is 1800000 bytes and exceeds the LFS threshold.
findings.action: Store large datasets, notebooks with embedded outputs, and model artifacts through Git LFS.

findings.title: schema.org metadata type is missing or unexpected
findings.action: Add schema.org ScholarlyArticle metadata to improve discoverability and export quality.

findings.title: Author metadata lacks ORCID
findings.evidence: Jordan Park has no ORCID in metadata.json.
findings.action: Request ORCID or mark the author as externally unverified before DOI minting.

findings.title: Public release lacks DOI metadata
findings.evidence: proj-neuro-marker-001 is marked public but has no DOI.
findings.action: Mint or reserve a DOI before publishing the tagged release.

findings.title: Release tag is not a valid semantic version
findings.action: Use a vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH tag before export or DOI citation.

findings.title: Version history lacks base or head commit
findings.action: Record base and head commits so rollback, provenance, and export bundle verification work.

findings.title: Release contains unreviewed changes
findings.action: Require merge request review before tagging the project repository.

findings.title: Fork provenance lacks attribution
findings.evidence: proj-neuro-marker-001 is a fork without parent project attribution.
findings.action: Store parent project ID and attribution text before allowing publication or export.

findings.title: Merge request has no reviewer approval
findings.evidence: proj-neuro-marker-001 requires MR review but has no reviewers.
findings.action: Require at least one reviewer approval before merging research changes into a release branch.

findings.title: Merge request still has unresolved discussions
findings.action: Resolve open review discussions before tagging the release.

findings.title: No reproducibility pipeline is configured
findings.evidence: proj-neuro-marker-001 has no pipeline path for auto-execution.
findings.action: Add a reproducibility pipeline that rebuilds results from raw data and code.

findings.title: Last reproducibility run did not pass
findings.action: Block citation/export until the sandboxed reproducibility run passes.

findings.title: Runtime environment is not pinned
findings.evidence: proj-neuro-marker-001 lacks a container image or conda environment file.
findings.action: Pin a container image or conda environment before claiming reproducible results.
